user.title: IKEA Sleepy Device Firmware Updater
user.description: Connect to your Home Assistant Matter Server. The URL is pre-filled from your existing Matter integration when available. By default every battery-powered IKEA Matter device (BILRESA, MYGGBETT, MYGGSPRAY, TIMMERFLOTTE, KLIPPBOK...) is watched; you can narrow this down later in the integration options.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Matter Server at the given URL.

abort.already_configured: IKEA Sleepy Device Firmware Updater is already configured.

init.title: Devices and keep-awake tuning
init.description: Only OTA-capable Matter devices exposing the ICD Management cluster (sleepy, battery-powered devices) are considered. Leave the product filter empty to watch all of them, or enter comma-separated product name fragments (for example: MYGGBETT, MYGGSPRAY). The re-send interval is used when the device does not report a promised active duration; lower values keep the device awake more reliably but use slightly more battery.
